text:
Add a standing test to the normal workspace gate (in xtask, next to xtask/src/decisions.rs) that renders a decision card for every real proposal title in the repository, not fixtures, under a time limit. It must fail if any render does not finish, or if any question is empty, does not end in '?', still contains a jargon token, or is identical for proposals with different titles. The failure message must list each failing title. This is separate from the queued third decision-card approach: the third approach should be judged by this test, and so should any later change to the card text rules.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Decision-card rewrites rejected three times in a row; text rules are only tested on hand-picked fixtures, never on real proposal titles
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: xtask/src/decisions.rs
